shots.visual: Wide night: dirt crossroads outside a small adobe village, flat-roof adobe church, wooden descanso cross on the roadside, mesa + full moon with halo; a black lump of wool lies in the middle of the crossroads
shots.camera: slow lateral dolly right-to-left (episode camera language)
shots.motion: wool lump heaves slowly; tumbleweed rolls across

shots.visual: La Mala Hora face fills frame: ash-grey split-tone face, black rebozo, long tangled black hair, hollow eyes with pinpoint highlights, stylised sharp teeth, no blood; light from below, shadow from above
shots.camera: whip-in from left edge, zoom 3.2 -> 1.45 in 0.16 s, hard shake decaying
shots.sfx: mala_hora_breath_hiss x3 (orig, -4 st, +5 st) + horror/sub_boom; captions hidden

shots.visual: Back to the crossroads wide, wool lump now closer to camera
Lone walker (hoodie, hands in pockets) from behind on a dirt lane along an adobe wall with red chile ristras hanging by a blue door
Low angle at road level: black wool lump in the exact center where four dirt roads meet
shots.motion: loose strands lift against the wind direction

shots.visual: HOOK CARD black, red text DON'T CROSS IT. (~150 px, glow)
shots.motion: a hooded-shawl shadow passes across the card (episode hook accent)

shots.visual: Extreme close-up: the wool is coarse, matted, too dark, the lump slowly rises and falls like breathing
High top-down view: tiny walker approaching the four-way crossroads, wool lump at center, nobody else for miles
shots.camera: top-down slow rotate (new angle for series)

shots.visual: TITLE CARD: row of farolitos (paper-bag candle lanterns) on an adobe wall light one by one left to right; LA MALA HORA rises in cream Oswald Bold (<=980 px); label NEW MEXICO · LEGEND, small red bar
shots.motion: candle flames flicker; each lantern ignites
shots.card: TITLE CARD: LA MALA HORA / NEW MEXICO · LEGEND
shots.transition: rebozo-wipe (black shawl sweeps across frame) 0.27 s

shots.visual: Old journal page on a wooden desk, big red-stamped 1910, header JOURNAL OF AMERICAN FOLK-LORE (no body text, just ruled lines)
1910 adobe room by oil lamp: folklorist in suit and round glasses writing in a notebook; window shows a dark village road
shots.card: STATE STAMP: NEW MEXICO outline in corner

shots.visual: Notebook page close-up: pencil sketch of a crossroads with a small black scribble at the center
Dark crossroads wide, mesa silhouette, cholla and yucca under the moon, New Mexico Zia-sun route marker on a post
1910-era lone traveler with a tin lantern on the dirt road, small against the night
A single lock of black wool tumbling slowly along the road toward the traveler's lantern light
shots.camera: low tracking shot following the wool

shots.visual: A whole sheep's fleece spread flat across the crossroads, empty, like a skin with nothing inside
shots.motion: fleece edges ripple as if something underneath shifts

shots.visual: The fleece slowly rises upright into a standing shape
shots.camera: slow tilt up with the shape

shots.visual: Woman in black from behind at the center of the crossroads: black rebozo, very long tangled hair to the knees, bare ash-grey hands
shots.camera: slow lateral arc around her back (face never shown)
shots.motion: hair and shawl move without wind

shots.visual: Slow push toward her back; the descanso cross in foreground blur
shots.motion: candle at the descanso gutters out

shots.visual: Modern walker's face, lit by phone glow, staring at the figure
POV from walker: her silhouette tiny at the crossroads; behind her, village houses
Adobe house in the distance, one warm window, silhouettes of a family inside; ristra by the door
Her black shape motionless at the crossroads under the moon
Walker passes close behind her, the rebozo edge in foreground
Walker heading home down an adobe street lined with farolitos; far behind, her small figure turned toward the walker
Three adobe doors side by side (blue, turquoise, brown) with ristras; the walker's hand reaches for one
shots.camera: slow lateral pass across the doors

shots.visual: Empty two-lane New Mexico highway at night, Zia-sun state route sign, desert, moon
shots.motion: car tail lights vanish over a rise
shots.card: ROAD SIGN: New Mexico Zia route marker

shots.visual: Two friends walking together with one phone flashlight; in-world red caption DON'T CROSS ALONE. (caption only, not a black card)
Back to the opening crossroads (loop): black wool lump in the road
shots.camera: same lateral dolly as s0 (loop seam)

shots.visual: Close: strands of the wool slowly reach toward camera like fingers of hair
FACE REVEAL by slow head turn: the woman in black, back to camera at the crossroads, turns her head slowly over the shoulder to show the ash-grey face, hollow eyes, stylised teeth; no blood
shots.camera: slow push while head turns (episode reveal style)
shots.sfx: mala_hora_breath_hiss (custom) + horror/sub_boom on final word; end 0.75 s after 'lose'
